independent_review.text:
# Independent review: frozen 42 schema composition V2

Supports the isolated composition V2, patch SHA-256 `e2487a573a64dace206b5e15c598738351d62b4a4d3087603f0711d82a2ba33e`, manifest `ac9724b95c15553ab4cd38782c44be94c94749d9028abedbff403f9b1b579a1a`, and 42-review document `939935d40c6bacc9b498043dbd69e9bc314adffe85e2029dd42df25a3141350e`. The previously reviewed source packet is frozen V4 `4050a7570eea08925e1ca3c03b9dfa3071563f019bbe8886a183f04628220fd0`; its explicit history of unavailable earlier V2 bytes remains in the archived packet. V1 composition remains retained.

Independent exact comparison of V1 and V2 review documents confirms the only per-review change is correcting the predecessor field name in each decision; all 42 full predecessor rows, reviews, source-transition assessments, current import data and prior conclusions remain exact. All 11 proposed repo-overlay files independently hash-match the V2 manifest, including the archived historical producer and complete V4 packet. The old a712 producer remains historical evidence, not a claim that the current producer has identical bytes.

An independent TypeScript JSON-AST comparison of the full 1,736-row ledgers confirmed exactly the V4's 42 distinct triples changed and the other 1,694 row object spans remained byte-identical and ordered. For every changed row, restoring its prior source_review and removing the appended history entry reconstructs the complete predecessor. The ledger patch applies with `--whitespace=error` in a private index based on 8f9f and produces candidate ledger SHA `c8a285334aca26618c551236e6be18f67089736aad1c31f4b2b804166d66e7da`. The live ledger was byte-identical to that base at the observed 11225 checkpoint; recheck at integration.

An independent invocation of the unchanged production authored-use helper on the proposal overlay reproduced baseline 1,367 reviewed / 369 insufficient and candidate 1,409 / 327, with exactly the 42 selected keys improved and no newly insufficient keys. Source, line and evidence-byte mutations each reopen all 42. The predecessor mutation is caught by the separate exact-composition validator; the unchanged helper does not inspect that predecessor metadata.

An additional independent full production CLI run in a Git-archive fixture at 11225 using the proposed overlay reproduced the same exact 42-key improvement with no newly insufficient keys. Both baseline and candidate exited 1 with overall admission incomplete, security not-passed and G11 not-passed. CLI reports and replay controls are retained in this directory. The helper and CLI authenticate source/evidence identities and structural consistency; this review's separate V4 source judgment supplies the semantic assessment. No new runtime, full floor, security or release qualification is claimed.
